                  id="Definitions_DevelopmentPromotion"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/development-promotion">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_DevelopmentPromotion" name="Employee Development and Promotion" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Process" name="Development needs or career aspirations identified">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_Identify</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_IdentifyNeeds" name="Identify development needs or career aspirations">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_Identify</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Identify_CreatePlan</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreatePlan" name="Manager and HR create a personal development plan">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Identify_CreatePlan</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CreatePlan_IterationMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_IterationMerge" name="Begin or continue development" gatewayDirection="Converging">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CreatePlan_IterationMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Milestones_NotReached</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_IterationMerge_ParallelSplit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_DevelopmentSplit" name="Continue development and feedback" gatewayDirection="Diverging">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_IterationMerge_ParallelSplit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_SkillEnhancement</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_Feedback</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_EnhanceSkills" name="Employee enhances skills">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_SkillEnhancement</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SkillEnhancement_Join</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_FeedbackEvaluation" name="Supervisors provide feedback and evaluate">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_Feedback</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Feedback_Join</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_DevelopmentJoin" name="Development and feedback complete" gatewayDirection="Converging">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SkillEnhancement_Join</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Feedback_Join</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Join_Milestones</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Milestones" name="Have milestones been reached?" gatewayDirection="Diverging" default="Flow_Milestones_NotReached">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Join_Milestones</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Milestones_Reached</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Milestones_NotReached</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ConsiderPromotion" name="Consider employee for promotion or a new role">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Milestones_Reached</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ConsiderPromotion_HRReview</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_HRReview" name="HR conducts formal performance review">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ConsiderPromotion_HRReview</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_HRReview_Approval</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PromotionApproval" name="Is the promotion approved?" gatewayDirection="Diverging" default="Flow_Approval_NotApproved">

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Finalize_Transition</bpmn:outgoing>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_TransitionRole" name="Employee transitions into the new role">

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Transition_EndPromoted</bpmn:outgoing>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Promoted" name="Employee promoted and in the new role">

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CreatePlan_IterationMerge" sourceRef="Task_CreatePlan" targetRef="Gateway_IterationMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_IterationMerge_ParallelSplit" sourceRef="Gateway_IterationMerge" targetRef="Gateway_DevelopmentSplit"/>

    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Approval_NotApproved" sourceRef="Gateway_PromotionApproval" targetRef="EndEvent_NotApproved"/>

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_ProvideFeedback</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_EnhanceSkills" name="Employee continues enhancing skills">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_EnhanceSkills</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_EnhanceSkills_DevelopmentMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProvideFeedback" name="Supervisors provide feedback and evaluate">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_ProvideFeedback</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ProvideFeedback_DevelopmentMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_DevelopmentMerge" name="Skill enhancement and feedback complete" gatewayDirection="Converging">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_EnhanceSkills_DevelopmentMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ProvideFeedback_DevelopmentMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DevelopmentMerge_CheckMilestones</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CheckMilestones" name="Have the milestones been reached?" gatewayDirection="Diverging" default="Flow_MilestonesNotReached">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DevelopmentMerge_CheckMilestones</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MilestonesReached</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MilestonesNotReached</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ConsiderPromotion" name="Consider employee for promotion or a new role">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MilestonesReached</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ConsiderPromotion_FormalReview</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_FormalReview" name="HR conducts a formal performance review">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ConsiderPromotion_FormalReview</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FormalReview_Approval</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PromotionApproval" name="Is the promotion approved?" gatewayDirection="Diverging" default="Flow_PromotionNotApproved">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FormalReview_Approval</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PromotionApproved</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PromotionNotApproved</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_FinalizePromotion" name="Finalize promotion with new responsibilities and compensation adjustments">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PromotionApproved</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Finalize_Transition</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_TransitionToNewRole" name="Employee transitions into the new role">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Finalize_Transition</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Transition_Promoted</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Promoted" name="Employee promoted and transitioned into the new role">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Transition_Promoted</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_PromotionNotApproved" name="Promotion not approved">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PromotionNotApproved</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_CreatePlan" sourceRef="StartEvent_NeedsIdentified" targetRef="Task_CreateDevelopmentPlan"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CreatePlan_DevelopmentSplit" sourceRef="Task_CreateDevelopmentPlan" targetRef="Gateway_DevelopmentSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_EnhanceSkills" sourceRef="Gateway_DevelopmentSplit" targetRef="Task_EnhanceSkills"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_ProvideFeedback" sourceRef="Gateway_DevelopmentSplit" targetRef="Task_ProvideFeedback"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EnhanceSkills_DevelopmentMerge" sourceRef="Task_EnhanceSkills" targetRef="Gateway_DevelopmentMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ProvideFeedback_DevelopmentMerge" sourceRef="Task_ProvideFeedback" targetRef="Gateway_DevelopmentMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DevelopmentMerge_CheckMilestones" sourceRef="Gateway_DevelopmentMerge" targetRef="Gateway_CheckMilestones"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MilestonesReached" sourceRef="Gateway_CheckMilestones" targetRef="Task_ConsiderPromotion">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">milestonesReached</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MilestonesNotReached" sourceRef="Gateway_CheckMilestones" targetRef="Gateway_DevelopmentSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ConsiderPromotion_FormalReview" sourceRef="Task_ConsiderPromotion" targetRef="Task_FormalReview"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FormalReview_Approval" sourceRef="Task_FormalReview" targetRef="Gateway_PromotionApproval"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PromotionApproved" sourceRef="Gateway_PromotionApproval" targetRef="Task_FinalizePromotion">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">promotionApproved</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PromotionNotApproved" sourceRef="Gateway_PromotionApproval" targetRef="EndEvent_PromotionNotApproved"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Finalize_Transition" sourceRef="Task_FinalizePromotion" targetRef="Task_TransitionToNewRole"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Transition_Promoted" sourceRef="Task_TransitionToNewRole" targetRef="EndEvent_Promoted"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

rules.instruction: When the description states that an ongoing activity continues while a separate review or decision proceeds: model the activities as concurrent paths with a parallel gateway, and synchronize them before any later step that depends on both paths being complete
rules.situation: the description states that an ongoing activity continues while a separate review or decision proceeds

rules.instruction: When the description explicitly states what triggers the process or what outcome terminates it: Label the corresponding start or end event with a concise, faithful description of that stated trigger or outcome rather than a generic label.
rules.situation: the description explicitly states what triggers the process or what outcome terminates it

rules.instruction: When the description explicitly includes a change to resources, terms, or entitlements as part of completing an outcome: Model that change as an activity in the outcome’s completion path.
rules.situation: the description explicitly includes a change to resources, terms, or entitlements as part of completing an outcome
